targets.doc/summary.md:
# Summary

The statute specifies that records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute. [[cite:obs-98b3220a840068062d5f8cf1e000b47ff8259aa5 "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]

The statute's retention rule is that records are kept according to the schedule defined within the statute itself. [[cite:obs-98b3220a840068062d5f8cf1e000b47ff8259aa5 "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]

The exact duration for which the records are kept is specified in that schedule, but the statute text does not provide a specific number of years. [[cite:obs-98b3220a840068062d5f8cf1e000b47ff8259aa5 "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]
